title: Gilev's Terrarium team GUI
description: Makes GUI of many Terrarium team mods more unique
body:
In my opinion the interface textures of some mods from Terrarium team lacked uniqueness so I created a resource pack to fix this
### With resource pack
![Example of GUI with resource pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9cf4b93bc8861d693837b2ced26bf8b15419d5bd_0.webp)
### Without resource pack
![Example of the same GUI without resource pack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3875c2a56b019279e62c6d9e19330c210ee8cd94_0.webp)

## Supported Mods
- Heracles
- Argonauts
- Cadmus
- Prometheus

> If you have any questions or suggestions you can write me on Discord: **gitgilev**
